method: the lines of a sentence joined, the names of formats/text/glossary_ja.json written into the sentence in English

......Hmm...... what a bother......


What is it? Do you need something from me...... Sorry, I was lost in thought......


Oh, that's right, you there, could you gather the Kokka eggs scattered outside?


That Kokka steals eggs from elsewhere and keeps them for himself...... Those poor eggs can't be left like that......


Bring them back safely and I'll tell you anything......

......

About the Evil Pigs!?...... Well, very well...... Spirited child, listen closely

If it's something I can help with, I'll gladly lend a hand......

I have a good eye for things, so if you get something you can't figure out how to use, bring it to me......


First, try meeting the chief of the Dwarves who live in the forest ahead...... He's sure to help you
entries.なんじゃ、解らない物があるなら見せてごらん・・・: What's this? If there's something you don't understand, show it to me......
entries.あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった・・・: Oh my...... you found me already......

Want me to tell you something good?


If you climb up ahead, a know-it-all old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there......


Well? You didn't know that, did you?

Want me to tell you something good?


If you go straight back behind this hut, there's a big puddle......


Well? Surprised, right?

If you go back behind the hut where I just was, there's a big puddle......

......Huh?......Oh, me? I'm......


......I'll tell you next time we meet!

entries.出会ったらまたおいでつぎこそオイラの事教えてやるよ: Meet me again and come back, and next time for sure I'll tell you about myself

......See, it wasn't a lie, was it?......

......Huh?......Oh, me? I'm Yan from the Hidden Village......

If you can keep finding me from here on, I'll tell you all sorts of other things...... if you can find me, that is


Hmm......I'm starting to have fun...... Do your best to find me, bye!

Thanks


I'll teach you my specialty


Press → together with □ and you can run as fast as I do


Well, see you

entries.おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!\n\n\nおまえ、とてもやさしいこころ:
Oh! You, you helped my child!


You have a very kind heart...... I'm very happy


As thanks, take this, it will surely be useful

......I can't get down......


I came looking for flower seeds, but...... there aren't any anywhere......


I want to go home......
entries.・・・おにいちゃん・・・つれてってくれるの?・・・・・・ありがとう!: ......Big brother...... will you take me with you?......Thank you!

I wish I could make flowers bloom in this flower bed......


Until a little while ago, there were lots of seeds in the forest, but now they've all withered......


Maybe they don't get enough nutrients......
entries.もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if I'll never see flowers again...
entries.おまえ、APと書かれたへんな塔見たか?: You, did you see the strange tower marked AP?
entries.わしらの仲間、あれと同じマークの入ったトビラや箱も見たこと、あるらしい: Our friends say they've seen doors and boxes with the same mark as that

Oh, you understand our language!?


We're in great trouble...... Won't you listen to what our Elder has to say?
entries.わしらの長老、しろいヒゲはやしているから、すぐわかる: Our Elder has a white beard, so you'll know him right away
entries.おお、少年よ・・・わしらの言葉を理解する知恵のある者よ・・・\n\n\nどうかわ:
Oh, boy...... one wise enough to understand our language......


Please lend us your strength......


The truth is, deep in this forest many of our friends have gone missing......
entries.どうにかして助けてやりたいのじゃが・・・: I'd like to help them somehow......
entries.おまえ、とても、ゆうきある。ドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする: You, very brave. Dwarves respect you

Brave boy...... please let me thank you on behalf of the whole Dwarf clan......


Thank you so much for saving our friends


And...... I will open the secret passages in the forest, so please feel free to use them
entries.魔ブタの力は強大じゃ・・・無理はせんようにな・・・: The Evil Pig's power is mighty...... Don't overdo it......
